name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine in Sudan; none newly confirmed
summary: IPC alert warns famine risk is rising in Darfur and Kordofan; no area newly classified as Famine found as of 24 Nov
state: An IPC alert published on 12 Oct warned of a growing risk of famine in parts of Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan, driven by conflict, displacement, an El Niño drought and funding gaps, but classified no area as Famine (AllAfrica). The IRC has warned that war and drought are depleting food stocks and pushing Sudan further towards famine. Searches on 24 Nov found no new Famine classification, so Watch holds.
for_you: Displaced families in Darfur and Kordofan, especially children, face the highest risk of acute malnutrition. Food prices and aid access in Sudan and neighbouring Chad are the main factors to follow.
rubric_hit: Watch: IPC risk-of-famine alert for parts of Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan (12 Oct); no Phase 5 area newly confirmed

sources.title: AllAfrica — Sudan: Drought and war push Darfur and Kordofan towards famine
IRC — War and El Niño-driven drought deplete food stocks, pushing Sudan further towards famine

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.

rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
